title: Excoriate
summary: EXCO'RIATE, verb transitive [Low Latin excorio; ex and corium, skin, hide.] To flay; to strip or wear off the skin; to abrade; to gall; to break and remove the cuticle in any manner, as by rubbing, be

inlines.v: EXCO'RIATE, verb transitive [Low Latin excorio; ex and corium, skin, hide.] To flay; to strip or wear off the skin; to abrade; to gall; to break and remove the cuticle in any manner, as by rubbing, beating, or by the action of acrid substances.
